name: com.terreinlab.importer
description: Imports TerreinLab models with the right settings by itself: an .fbx with metadata.json and ATTRIBUTION.txt beside it arrives in metres with clean axes, without lightmap UVs over RoadUV, with 32-bit indices where needed, a full-size aerial, normal maps and GPU instancing. The FBX custom properties land on a TerreinLabProperties component, and the model root gets a TerreinLabModel component that converts Unity positions to RD and NAP and back.
